    private static void
    SeedData.seedActiveDeals(DataStore store, LocalDateTime now, Buyer demo, Seller alice, Seller bob, Listing headphones, Listing hoodie, Listing calcr)
    Active deals for the demo buyer, so the buyer side of seller decisions (Task 2) can be shown on its own: a counter-offer to answer, an accepted giveaway claim to mark complete, and a short borrow that counts down, sends a reminder and is auto-returned a few minutes after the first start.
